units: <cite ref="Yoma 81b">Yoma 81ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 36b:14">Ber. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>כַּס פילפלי וכ׳</he> if one chewed pepper on the Day of Atonement.

<cite ref="Megillah 7b:4">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>בעאי למֵיכַס וכ׳</he> I should have liked to chew the plate after it; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1059:13">Yalk. Esth. 1059</cite> <he>דאִיכְסִיסֵיה</he> (not <he>דאיב׳</he>).

senses.gloss: [to cut or scratch off, peel, diminish, (v. P. Sm. 1777),] to rebuke, chastise (v. כְּסַן).
units: Targ. Prov. IX, 8 תִכוּס (ed. Lag. תָכֵיס Af.).
<cite ref="Ketubot 77a:14">Keth. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>אַכְסוּהוּ שערי וכ׳</he> give El. barley to chew (as to an animal, i.e. he is an ignoramus).
<cite ref="Ketubot 77a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>על דא אכסוה וכ׳</he> on account of this (opinion), they gave El. barley to eat in Babylonia.

senses.gloss: to rebuke, chastise. Targ. Prov. l. c., v. supra. Ib. XXVIII, 23.
